item.title: What Led to Trump Firing Homeland Security Sec. Kristi Noem?
item.description: President Donald Trump has fired Homeland Security Secretary Kristi Noem on Thursday, making her the first cabinet member to be removed in Trump’s second term. An administration official tells NBC News the move was due to a culmination of Noem’s “many unfortunate leadership failures,” most recently a grilling on Capitol Hill over a $220 million border security ad campaign that featured her prominently. NBC’s Garrett Haake reports and Moderator of Meet the Press Kristen Welker joins TOD

item.title: Obama: Rev. Jesse Jackson 'inspires us to take a harder path'
item.description: Former President Barack Obama spoke at the funeral service for Rev. Jesse Jackson in Chicago, remembering him as a "born leader" who "rose above despair" to advocate for civil rights. He recounted the accomplishments and hardships the reverend overcame and how his legacy "inspires us to take a harder path."

item.title: Iran war threatens Trump's affordability push as rising energy prices complicate Fed rate cuts
item.description: The war with Iran is quickly becoming an economic problem for the United States — and a policy dilemma for the Federal Reserve

item.title: Iran's foreign minister denies seeking war with its neighbors
item.description: Since the U.S. and Israel launched attacks across Iran last weekend, the Islamic Republic has retaliated by firing missiles and drones across the region, striking Bahrain, Qatar, the United Arab Emirates and other countries.

item.title: Special Report: NBC News exclusive interview with Iran’s foreign minister on war with U.S.
item.description: Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi spoke with “NBC Nightly News" anchor Tom Llamas in a video interview from Tehran as U.S. and Israeli bombs continue to hammer the country. Araghchi said that Iran is ready for a U.S. ground invasion of the country as the war between Iran, the U.S. and Israel has quickly spread across the region. He also refused any negotiations with the U.S. and said that Iran had not asked for a ceasefire.

item.title: 'Either freedom or death': Young Iranian man says he's willing to die for democracy
item.description: In an exclusive interview, a young man in Iran's war zone weighs what may come next for his country as the war escalates in the Middle East.

item.title: Russia is providing intelligence to Iran on the location of U.S. forces, sources say
item.description: Russia is providing intelligence to Iran on the location of U.S. forces in the Middle East, a boost for the Tehran regime as it launches missile and drone attacks on American bases and other targets in the region, according to four sources with knowledge of the matter.

item.title: Sources: Deadly strike on Iranian school likely from U.S. munition
item.description: On the first day of the war with Iran, a missile strike on an elementary school killed more than 170 people according to Iranian officials. Now one U.S. official and one person familiar with the preliminary findings of the U.S. investigation into the attack say it looks increasingly likely that a U.S. munition was responsible for the strike. NBC News’ Molly Hunter reports.

item.title: Trump demands ‘unconditional surrender’ from Iran
item.description: President Trump posted there would be no deal with Iran without ‘unconditional surrender’ as the U.S. and Israel launched another wave of devastating strikes against the Iranian regime. NBC News’ Richard Engel reports.
